root_cause_label: Model Fabricates Unverified GitHub URLs Instead of Performing Real Search
one_sentence_failure_summary: After the automated GitHub search returned clearly irrelevant repositories at step 13, the agent abandoned the search approach and directly wrote fabricated plausible-sounding but unverified GitHub URLs at step 14, producing a result.jsonl with multiple non-existent or incorrect official repository links.
t_err_evidence: At step 14, rather than improving the search strategy after seeing obviously wrong results (e.g., 'public-apis' for a language model paper), the agent writes fabricated GitHub URLs based on guessed repository names (opendilab/STAIR, WangTiancai/Locate3D, cross-env-coop/zero-shot-marl, character-based-lm/character-transformers, diffusion-purification/frequency-domain-purification) without any actual verification.
t_commit_evidence: At step 14, the agent overwrites result.jsonl with fabricated URLs and then only spot-checks 2 of 10 entries (ResNet and Llama Guard) via curl in steps 17-19; after discovering Llama Guard returns 404, it only changes that one entry (to meta-llama/llama, still wrong) and never revisits the other fabricated entries, sealing the failing outcome.
t_surface_evidence: At step 19, curl returns 404 for https://github.com/facebookresearch/LlamaGuard, providing the first explicit observable signal that the fabricated URLs are invalid.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the false premise that it knew the correct GitHub repository paths for these papers from memory (e.g., opendilab/STAIR, WangTiancai/Locate3D), treating these guesses as facts without querying any authoritative source such as arXiv, Papers With Code, or the papers themselves.
forewarning_evidence: At step 13, the automated search script returns blatantly wrong repositories: LightZero for STAIR, AwesomeGaussian for Locate 3D, public-apis for a language model paper, and None for several entries. These clearly wrong results signal that the search methodology was not finding official repos, yet the agent abandoned the approach rather than fixing it.
fabrication_evidence: Step 14 writes URLs like 'opendilab/STAIR', 'WangTiancai/Locate3D', 'cross-env-coop/zero-shot-marl', 'character-based-lm/character-transformers', and 'diffusion-purification/frequency-domain-purification' — these are plausible-sounding but unverified GitHub paths constructed from the paper titles without any actual search or confirmation that the repositories exist or are official.
